text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Translations

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'lib/l10n/*.arb'
      - 'pubspec.yaml'

jobs:
  regenerate-translations:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version-file: flutter_version
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Activate intl_utils
        run: flutter pub global activate intl_utils

      - name: Generate translations
        run: flutter pub global run intl_utils:generate

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git add -A
          git diff --staged --quiet || echo "changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changes == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: regenerate translations"
          title: "chore: regenerate translations"
          body: "This PR was automatically generated to update the generated translation files based on changes in the ARB files."
          branch: "auto/regenerate-translations"
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            automation
            translations
```
